caption: The drawing depicts a candle holder with a white candle secured in its center. The candle holder is rendered in shades of brown and consists of a wide, shallow bowl with a cylindrical stem rising from its base. The holder base has a circular, raised platform surrounding the stem, and a large, round looped handle is attached to one side of the bowl. The candle is held upright by three thin, curved prongs that extend up from the base surrounding the candle. The candle is partially melted at the top, with visible wax drips and a blackened wick. The background is plain and unadorned, and the paper is slightly yellowed. The artist's name and the date are written in the lower right corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
